title: ‘Our daughters knew and trusted him’: Gymnastics instructor in Mass., R.I., allegedly used AI to make pornographic videos of children he coached
summary: A youth gymnastics and cheerleading instructor was charged in federal court for filming students and using AI to create pornographic videos of children.
